column1: # Mesh questions for scripts/local-ai-agents.sh test. Columns, separated by a TAB: id, question, expect.
# expect is a substring check, not a judgement. The answer is lowercased and backticks and asterisks are removed.
#   a && b      both must appear         a || b   either may appear         a >> b   b must appear after a
# Every expected word is in local-ai/primer.md (so the question is answerable from it), and tests/scripts/test-local-ai-primer.sh
# fails if one does not, or if the question text itself already contains it.

column2: question

Why can edits I make inside the .stack-src folder disappear?

make kind-up cannot give ArgoCD read access when I run it from a linked git worktree. Which environment variable avoids that?
